test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: When an article is sold at Rs. 8,40,000, then the profit percentage is 20%. What is the cost price of the article?
solution:
Given:

Selling price = Rs. 8,40,000

Profit = 20%

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + profit%)

Calculation:

Cost price of the article = 840000 ÷ (1 + 20%)

⇒ 840000 ÷ 1.2 = Rs. 7,00,000

∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 7,00,000.
